deviations_from_card: (1) Write set: view.ts was added as the coupled file, as the coordinator directed. The caption tag, the help button's label and help text, and whether it is offered all come from helpOf(c) in view.ts, which the TV row and LingaPhone both read. LingaTV.tsx and uat/driver/linga-text.cjs needed no edit because both render from the view, so the driver sees the new labels and 'Said more simply: ...' caption lines with no change of its own. (2) Conversation.help is {forTurn, rungs, rung, shown}, not just {forTurn, rung}. rungs lists which rungs survived validation (numbers only, never words), so the view can name the next step and hide the button at the top of the ladder. shown is false after a quiz, a choice or coach, so the rung tag never sits over the quiz's scene cue. (3) rung is the rung's kind (1 simpler, 2 meaning, 3 starter), not a count. A ladder whose simpler line was dropped starts at rung 2. (4) At the top of the ladder, another cue keeps the last rung on screen, and the TV and phone stop offering the help button. 'Choose a phrase' takes its slot on the TV. (5) Extra: the cue command now records its commandId, so a retried request cannot climb two rungs (asserted in case 6). (6) Commit order: feat first, then the test commit, so each commit is green, following the linga A precedent. Red-before was measured on the tree before building: 6/7 red, with case 7 the GUARD and green. (7) Case 5 also drives the real text() with a registry stub provider. A help with a 400-character simpler line and a numeric starter costs those rungs, not the turn.
notes: Ladder words live only in globalThis.__lingaHelp (help.ts), a Map from partner turn id to rungs, capped at 200 entries. Each new partner line deletes the previous line's entry. Tests clear it with globalThis.__lingaHelp.clear(). The session stays word-free until a rung is revealed; the revealed rung sits in c.cue. The model is asked for help:{simpler,meaning,starter} (codex strict: every field is required, and empty strings are allowed) in openingSchema, turnSchema and replaySchema. The accept shapes (openingAccept, turnAccept, replayAccept) leave help optional and unchecked ({}). Validation is code in help.ts. simpler must be shorter than the line, differ from it, and end in '?' when the line asks a question. meaning is at most 160 characters. starter must be unfinished: no ending in . ! or ?, at most 8 words and 80 characters, and ' …' is added when missing. Only rung 3 (SUPPORTING_RUNG) makes the reply supported. If the partner line itself was supportProvided:true, c.supported was already true, as before. The tutor system prompt gains one paragraph describing help, so a live run changes the prompt. No live model call was made. Not screenshot-verified, and LT has not been re-run: the next LT recert should check J4 (LT-tomas-9-J4-1, LT-petra-38-J4-2, LT-viktor-67-J4-1) and whether 'On your own' becomes reachable. For uat A: the 'cue' action id is unchanged. Its label is now 'Help me answer' or 'More help', and it disappears at the top of the ladder.
